title: This was the call of life to his soul not the dull gross voice of the world of duties and despair, not the inhuman voice that had called him to the pale service of the altar.
html_source: The call Joyce is referring to is the one that tells Stephen he should become an artist. This happens right after Stephen decides to no longer pursue priesthood and is left without knowing what to do. Therefore, he has an epiphany to celebrate life, humanity and freedom. Overall, Joyce is trying to show that someone can’t just decide they want to become a true artist, but instead, they have to feel a strong calling.
